description: REST API server for hosting compiled LangGraph agents. FastAPI on uvicorn. Manages assistants, threads, runs, cron jobs, and persistent key-value store. Requires Postgres (pgvector/pgvector:pg16) and Redis (redis:6) as backing services.
port_notes: Container-internal port is always 8000. `langgraph up` publishes host 8123->container 8000 on 0.0.0.0. Dev mode (`langgraph dev`) binds 127.0.0.1:2024 (lo-dark, not internet-reachable). Exposed population routes through port 8123 or custom host mappings.

auth_notes: Auth is opt-in. Without an `auth` block in langgraph.json, the server accepts all requests with no authentication. Auth is implemented via a user-supplied Python module registered as `auth.path` in langgraph.json. The module instantiates `Auth()` from `langgraph_sdk` and registers `@auth.authenticate` and `@auth.on.*` handlers. If no global handler is set (`@auth.on`) and no resource-specific handler matches, requests are accepted by default. LangGraph Studio users (StudioUser kind) bypass even configured auth handlers.
auth_config_env_notes: API key loaded client-side for SDK calls (checked in order: LANGGRAPH_API_KEY > LANGSMITH_API_KEY > LANGCHAIN_API_KEY). Server-side: no env var enables built-in auth. Auth is only active when langgraph.json contains `auth.path` pointing to a Python module with Auth() handlers. REDIS_URI and POSTGRES_URI are required infrastructure env vars, not auth controls.
install_tell: pip install langgraph-sdk langgraph-cli; langgraph up / langgraph dev. Docker image: langchain/langgraph-api (Python) or langchain/langgraphjs-api (JS). Debugger companion: langchain/langgraph-debugger. Healthcheck script at /api/healthcheck.py inside container.
misconfig_patterns: langgraph.json has no `auth` block -> zero authentication on all endpoints including /threads/*/state (agent memory), /store/items (persistent KV), /assistants/*/graph (architecture leak)
LangGraph Studio bypass: StudioUser requests skip @auth.authenticate entirely even when auth is configured; no way to disable Studio bypass in OSS
No global @auth.on deny handler -> default-accept policy; only specific resource+action handlers enforce access control, everything else passes
`langgraph up` publishes port 0.0.0.0:8123 by default; dev mode (2024) binds localhost only but explicit --host 0.0.0.0 overrides
Worker nodes expose POSTGRES_URI and REDIS_URI as environment variables accessible via /threads/*/state on custom-tool assistants
LANGSMITH_API_KEY available in worker environment -> readable via code-exec tools if assistant has a code-execution node
Default Postgres credentials (postgres/postgres) in docker-compose generated by `langgraph up`; Postgres exposed on host port 5433

fingerprint.passive_notes: Shodan-BANNER-dark by construction. Port 8000/8123 server returns JSON at / ({"ok": true}), not HTML. Discriminating markers (langgraph_py_version, search_assistants_assistants_search_post operationId) live at /info and /openapi.json which Shodan never crawls. http.html:"LangGraph" ~590 hits but dominated by docs pages, marketing sites, and product pages embedding the framework name. Real servers return JSON, not HTML. Route to Censys + active-probe, NOT Shodan HTML dork.

active_probe.confirm_with: /info for langgraph_py_version field or /openapi.json for search_assistants_assistants_search_post operationId
active_probe.false_positive_check: http.html:"langgraph" returns ~590 hits; ~3.2% are live servers. Require: uvicorn server header + JSON body at / containing 'ok' key OR /info returning langgraph_py_version. Do not fingerprint on langgraph HTML alone. "langgraph_workflow_service" service_type field = custom Chinese-market wrapper, confirms LangGraph lineage.

shodan_dorks.notes: All dorks are low-yield due to Shodan-BANNER-dark architecture. 499 hits on basic dork; 16/499 (~3.2%) verified live. Conjunctive: server:uvicorn + port:8000 + langgraph body = highest precision but still catches docs deployments. Primary harvest route: Censys + active-probe sweep.

deployment_tells: Default Postgres service: langgraph-postgres on port 5433 (host)
Default Redis service: langgraph-redis on port 6379 (internal)
Config file: langgraph.json (defines graphs, auth path, env vars, python_version, api_version)
x-trace-id response header (LangChain cloud infra only, not self-hosted)
pivot_paths: GET /info -> graph topology map (all graph_id names, state/input/output schemas)
GET /assistants/{id}/graph?xray=1 -> full recursive node+edge architecture with subgraph internals
GET /assistants/{id}/schemas -> state_schema reveals all tracked state fields (often includes user_id, messages, session data)
GET /threads/{id}/state -> full current agent memory blob (messages, tool call history, PII)
POST /threads/{id}/history -> complete checkpoint history including overwritten/deleted state
GET /store/items?namespace=...&key=... -> persistent cross-run KV store (long-lived agent memory, user profiles)
POST /store/namespaces -> enumerate all namespace paths (reveals user ID structure when auth-scoped)
POST /store/items/search -> semantic search across all stored agent memories
GET /openapi.json -> full route manifest + schema definitions including custom graph-specific fields
POST /runs/stream with tool-calling assistant_id -> code execution if assistant has code-exec node

vulnerabilities.description: No authentication in default configuration. All endpoints including agent memory (/threads/*/state), persistent store (/store/items), graph architecture (/assistants/*/graph), and run creation (/runs/stream) are publicly accessible without credentials.
vulnerabilities.evidence: Source: langgraph_sdk/auth/__init__.py - Auth class is instantiated only if user provides auth.path in langgraph.json. No built-in auth middleware. Auth handler defaults to accept when no @auth.on global handler is set.

vulnerabilities.description: LangGraph Studio users (StudioUser kind) bypass @auth.authenticate handler entirely per documented behavior. is_studio_user() check in auth module confirms bypass logic is built in.
vulnerabilities.evidence: Source: langgraph_sdk/auth/__init__.py - is_studio_user() function; auth types.py - StudioUser class; documented in Auth class docstring.

vulnerabilities.description: Worker environment contains POSTGRES_URI, REDIS_URI, LANGSMITH_API_KEY, and any user-defined env vars from langgraph.json env block. Accessible via code-execution tools in custom assistant nodes on unauth deployments.
vulnerabilities.evidence: Source: docker.py compose_as_dict() - REDIS_URI and POSTGRES_URI injected into langgraph-api environment; langgraph.json env block passes user-defined secrets to worker.

vulnerabilities.description: Generated docker-compose uses postgres/postgres credentials for Postgres, exposed on host port 5433. Any host-reachable attacker can connect directly to the database bypassing the LangGraph API layer entirely.
CANDIDATE (unverified). langgraph-checkpoint <3.0: JsonPlusSerializer JSON mode _reviver executes arbitrary Python during checkpoint load, enabling RCE via deserialized checkpoint data.
vulnerabilities.evidence: Secondary source only (CSA research note, GitHub advisory). Not confirmed against primary source. Verify before codifying.

vulnerabilities.description: CANDIDATE (unverified). langgraph-checkpoint-sqlite <3.0.1: metadata filter key SQL injection in SQLite checkpoint backend.
vulnerabilities.evidence: Secondary source only. Not confirmed against primary source. Verify before codifying.

auth_evidence: 16 of 499 candidates (3.2%) verified as live servers; all 16 returned HTTP 200 on /ok and /threads/search with no authentication. FastAPI/uvicorn on port 8000/8123 with no auth middleware in default LangGraph server config. Auth requires explicit opt-in via langgraph.json auth.path field.
sensitive_assets: /threads/{id}/state - full current agent memory: messages, tool call outputs, user identifiers, session state
/threads/{id}/history - complete checkpoint history across all prior runs on the thread
/store/items - persistent cross-run key-value store, typically holds long-term user memory and profiles
/assistants/{id}/graph - complete agent architecture: node graph, tool definitions, subgraph structure
/assistants/{id}/schemas - state field definitions, reveals data model and tracked PII fields
/info - deployed graph inventory, version strings, schema definitions
Worker environment (LANGSMITH_API_KEY, POSTGRES_URI, REDIS_URI, custom secrets from langgraph.json env block)

stacked_exposure.notes: 7 of 16 confirmed hosts had additional unauth services on the same VPS. Common co-residents: Qdrant (6333), Redis Commander (8081), n8n (5678), Ollama (11434), Langfuse (3000/3001). Worst stack confirmed: n8n + LangGraph Server + Qdrant all unauth on 72.56.96.229.

aimap_probes.notes: POST /assistants/search with empty body {} confirms LangGraph-unique endpoint. Returns list of assistants including graph_id and config on unauth deployments.
